description: This file defines an abstract Android Activity class named MaxAspectRatio with three nested subclasses representing different aspect ratios.

classes.name: MaxAspectRatio
classes.description: An abstract Activity class for managing maximum aspect ratio configurations.

classes.name: MaxAspectRatio.Square
classes.description: A subclass of MaxAspectRatio representing a square aspect ratio setting.

classes.name: MaxAspectRatio.SixteenToNine
classes.description: A subclass of MaxAspectRatio representing a 16:9 aspect ratio setting.

classes.name: MaxAspectRatio.Any
classes.description: A subclass of MaxAspectRatio indicating no specific aspect ratio restrictions.
